source_freeze: parent freezes all final shared source changes and records source snapshot before execution

protocol.corrector: common original physical L-BFGS-B, same finite allowances and caller whole-process eligibility
protocol.selection: minimum original paid physical Phi; secondary minimum prior among candidates in the predeclared ball
protocol.primary: all eligible paid physical candidates including original initial material
protocol.prior: per unchanged qualified model: R8vector edge/l2; scalar smooth1e-4/tv1e-4/epsilon.01
protocol.scope: three independent new vector geometries plus crossgrid pair; two actual measured inputs; two same-object classic diagnoses
protocol.outcome: retain all losses/failures and finite budget stops; no pass threshold, winner quota or adaptive case selection
protocol.ball_qualification: matched vector known iidCN99; crossgrid vector includes unresolved model mismatch; Fresnel/classic fixed discrepancy balls are not CN99 certificates
protocol.truth_access: NONE online; no material truth or heldout observations read until complete expected-task seal reviewed and authorized

queue.queue_order: fixed family,case,method order; finite ready queue; no outcome-dependent adaptation

adapter_contracts.vector3d: VectorPublicModel; native3D VectorPR3D CIE/Dual/global; source-normalized physical objective
adapter_contracts.fresnel: SourceSpecificPublicModel; projector_S list; R8 source-specific calibrated measured CIE/Dual/global
adapter_contracts.classic_G19: physical warm R8loop with EqualAreaGreen/PaperOneHop; explicit global stop convention; full masks16 on32²
adapter_contracts.classic_mature: cold paperloop; original perstage coefficient stops; DPCS15,mf5/8/10,materialbeta8/2/.5,Dualcurrent8
adapter_contracts.event_integer: 128AP preparation then finite integer normal event and ordinaryDR; common steps/audits/model
